name: Frigate Cameras
description: Live camera wall for a local Frigate NVR — auto-discovers every camera, with Grid, Spotlight, and Cycle views.

options.label: Frigate URL
options.help: Frigate's internal (unauthenticated) address, e.g. http://<your-frigate-ip>:5000 — not the login port 8971.

options.label: Stills instead of live video
options.help: Auto-refreshing snapshots instead of moving MJPEG — much lighter on the Frigate server for big grids.

options.label: Cameras (optional)
options.help: Comma-separated camera names to show, in order — blank shows every camera Frigate reports.
